compare.parsedValues: compare parsed JSON values, not bytes (the Foundation encoder writes 1e-07 where JS writes 1e-7)
compare.exact: integers, timestamps, state, due, reps, lapses, ids, queues, strings
compare.tolerance: stability and difficulty: absolute 1e-8 (ts-fsrs rounds with Math.round(x * 1e8) / 1e8); recall: relative 1e-12
compare.absentKeys: a missing key is not null (for example last_review on a new card)
compare.structural: compare previews and states structurally, never through JSON.stringify (key order)

cases.name: mixed: own, dict and retired entries, patches, issues, log, open session, a sense task that no longer resolves
